name: jsbridge
description: JS layer for the Android clipper: builds clipper-bundle.js from the vendored obsidian-clipper (git submodule) plus our webextension-polyfill shim; vitest + linkedom test harness.

scripts.verify: node build.mjs --prod && git add -N ../android/app/src/main/assets/clipper-bundle.js && git diff --exit-code -- ../android/app/src/main/assets/clipper-bundle.js
